items.question: What term life insurance options do we offer?
items.answer:
We offer flexible term life insurance with the following options:
- Coverage amounts: $50,000 to $5,000,000
- Term lengths: 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30 years
- Convertible to whole life (available within first 5 years)
- No medical exam required for coverage up to $250,000 (simplified issue)
- Rates starting at $25/month for $250,000 coverage (healthy non-smokers age 30-40)
- Optional riders: Accidental death, waiver of premium, child term rider

items.question: What are our whole life insurance features?
items.answer:
Our whole life insurance provides:
- Guaranteed lifetime coverage (premiums never increase)
- Cash value accumulation (grows tax-deferred at 3-5% annually)
- Loan options against cash value (up to 90% of cash value)
- Paid-up additions available
- Dividend payments (not guaranteed, based on company performance)
- Coverage amounts: $25,000 to $2,000,000
- No medical exam for simplified whole life up to $100,000
- Living benefits for terminal illness

items.question: Do you offer life insurance for seniors?
items.answer:
Yes! We offer specialized life insurance for seniors (ages 50-85):
- Guaranteed acceptance whole life (ages 50-85, no medical exam, coverage up to $50,000)
- Graded benefit period (full benefits after 2 years; premiums returned plus 10% if death occurs in first 2 years)
- Fixed premiums that never increase
- Coverage for final expenses, debts, or legacy planning
- Simple application process (3-5 questions only)
- Rates from $40/month for $10,000 coverage
